findings.reproduction: Advance a draft, close to Browse, then open Submit again.
findings.evidence: Navigation guard resetSubmissionToBrowseCenter; user confirmed this behavior on 2026-10-19.
findings.decision: Restart at Locate using Browse location and retain entered content. Do not change to resume the prior step. Refresh within Submit does retain the current step.

findings.reproduction: Scan any page; viewport has user-scalable=no.
findings.evidence: axe meta-viewport rule in checkpoint JSON.
findings.decision: User explicitly requested keeping this setting for now on 2026-10-19. Continue reporting; exempt only this rule from strict blocking. This is not an accessibility compliance claim.

findings.reproduction: Open empty Browse, a missing suggestion, or Review with a display name.
findings.evidence: docs/usability-evidence/contrast-empty-before.json, contrast-empty-after.json, contrast-review-before.json, contrast-review-after.json; full report includes all device profiles.
findings.decision: User approved darkening these text colors. Light colors changed to zinc-600; dark colors and layout preserved. Approved states pass color-contrast regression assertions on Android and iPhone, both themes.

findings.reproduction: Block external requests and open the app; icon-only controls were blank because Font Awesome CSS came from cdnjs.
findings.evidence: Initial blocked-network screenshot and index.html CDN reference; existing npm dependency was unused.
findings.decision: Imported the installed Font Awesome package from src/main.js and removed the CDN stylesheet. Blocked-network icon regression passed on Android/iPhone and the production build succeeds.

findings.reproduction: Measure toolbar buttons: current controls are 40px high and icon buttons 40px wide.
findings.evidence: docs/usability-evidence/approved-fixes/toolbar-before.png; tests/ux/snapshots/win32/*/toolbar.png. New size assertions failed before the fix; passed afterward, including 320px.
findings.decision: User approved 2026-10-19: increase toolbar touch targets to at least 44x44 CSS pixels while retaining compact layout. Added minimum-size and viewport-fit assertions.
findings.regression: tests/ux/journeys.spec.js and tests/ux/audit.js; affected journeys passed on Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit, both themes. See docs/usability-evidence/approved-fixes/validation.md.

findings.reproduction: Open search results above an open Browse tray; axe flags underlying sort controls.
findings.evidence: search-results checkpoint target-size rule and overlap observations.
findings.decision: User confirmed intentional behavior on 2026-10-19: search suggestions may temporarily cover Browse sort controls. Preserve this overlay behavior; do not propose changing it again without new evidence of an interaction failure.

findings.reproduction: At Review, clear display name, enter an invalid email and press Submit.
findings.decision: User approved light-theme red-600 and, after reproduction showed 3.26:1 contrast in dark mode, also approved dark-theme red-300 on 2026-10-19. Both name/email validation messages now have theme-specific colors. review-invalid has a blocking contrast regression assertion.
findings.regression: tests/ux/journeys.spec.js and tests/ux/audit.js; affected journeys passed on Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit, both themes. See docs/usability-evidence/approved-fixes/validation.md.

findings.reproduction: Open Marker settings over Browse and rotate to landscape.
findings.evidence: docs/usability-evidence/approved-fixes/settings-before.png and settings-after.png. First-control visibility assertion failed before the fix and passed afterward.
findings.decision: User approved 2026-10-19: expand settings trays on landscape screens up to 500px tall, preserving portrait layout and toolbar clearance. Added first-control visibility and sticky close-button assertions.
findings.regression: tests/ux/journeys.spec.js and tests/ux/audit.js; affected journeys passed on Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit, both themes. See docs/usability-evidence/approved-fixes/validation.md.
